# The edits the tests make to the feature workbooks, one a line: name|workbook|operation|arguments
#   combo|<sheet index>|<row to delete after the two inserted rows>
#       Insert two whole rows at the top, insert one whole column at the left, delete one whole row, rename the sheet to Renamed.
#   movesheet|<from>|<to>      move a sheet to a position (both counted from 0, chart sheets included)
#   delsheet|<index>           delete a sheet
# Excel performs each of them through edit-features.ps1 and the engine through tests/features.rs, and the two results are compared.
